EC1: Patients who have taken either morphine [OR] with daily dose more than 120mg or Fentanyl with daily dose more than 50ug/hr
EC2: Patients with significant abnormalities in hepatic [OR] or renal function which would, in the opinion of the investigator, prevent the patients involvement in the study
EC3: Patients with significant clinical abnormalities in [OR] CNS, respiratory or cardiovascular function, which in the investigators judgement prevents participation in the study
EC4: Patients who have taken antidepressants [OR] or anti-epileptic drugs [OR], sedative hypnotics [OR], selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor [OR], short-acting analgesics [OR], topical medications [OR] and anesthetics [OR] and/or muscle relaxants when taking Tramadol [OR]/Acetaminophen
